DOTA_Crownfall_EncounterDesc_Survivors: Survive against Imperia's demon hordes, power up and fight the Queen!
DOTA_Crownfall_Controls_MoveDescription: Click and drag to move your hero around the map
DOTA_Survivors_PowerupPopupDescription: Add or upgrade an item or ability
DOTA_Survivors_OptionalBossFightsDescrip: Defeat mini bosses to earn special upgrades for your abilities.
DOTA_Survivors_UpgradesDescription: Collect gold, upgrade stats, kill more enemies.
DOTA_Survivors_DifficultyDescription: Defeat Imperia across stacking levels of difficulty for a higher score!
DOTA_Survivors_ToggleFilterTokenTooltip: Toggle to enable/disable filtering by required tokens during hero pick.
DOTA_Survivors_PatchNotes_1_1_Items_001: Octarine Core: Cooldown Reduction Multiplier reduced from 6% to 5% per level.
DOTA_Survivors_PatchNotes_1_1_Items_002: Timeless Relic: Max level lowered from 3 to 2.
DOTA_Survivors_PatchNotes_1_1_Abilities_: Proximity Mines: Base Cooldown reduced from 5s to 4s.
Proximity Mines: Reworked Aghanim's Scepter: Lower cooldown by 20%. Now have a chance to plant Stasis Traps (lower damage, applies stun) and Remote Mines (higher damage, no trigger time).
Knife Throw: Cooldown Scaling changed to reduce cooldown by a flat 0.3s at odd levels. (Cooldown is 0 at max level)
Knife Throw: Pierce scaling changed to give 1 additional pierce at levels 3 and 5.
Knife Throw: Reworked Scepter: Knives now have infinite pierce.
Spirits: Reworked Scepter: Spirits now trigger explosions upon impact.
Counter Helix: Aghanim's Scepter: Internal cooldown increased from 0.05s to 0.15s.
Counter Helix: Base damage increased from 20 to 25.
Counter Helix: Damage Scaling per level increased from 10 to 15.
Mortimer's Kisses: Base damage increased from 5 to 6.
Mortimer's Kisses: Damage scaling per level increased from 3 to 4.
Frostbite: Base Target Count increased from 1 to 2.
Frostbite: Target Count scaling at levels 2 and 6 increased from 1 to 2.
Magic Missile: Aghanim's Scepter: Decreased damage gained per kill from 0.04 to 0.035.
Vengeful Spirit's Innate Unending Terror: Increased damage physical resistance reduction from 20% to 30%.
DOTA_Survivors_PatchNotes_1_1_Other_001: The player now has a green glow around them to help with visibility.
DOTA_Survivors_PatchNotes_1_1_Other_002: Vases during the Imperia fight now always have a guaranteed cheese.
DOTA_Survivors_PatchNotes_1_1_Other_003: Fix pickups occasionally dropping outside of the world.
DOTA_Survivors_PatchNotes_1_1_Other_004: Knockback from projectiles now always go in the direction of the projectile's velocity upon impact.
DOTA_Survivors_PatchNotes_1_1_Other_005: Fix not correctly showing all available level up or item choices when there were 3 or less available choices.
DOTA_Survivors_PatchNotes_1_1_Other_006: Fix collision indicator on Wailing Mass not being correctly aligned.
DOTA_VisualNovel_act4_Dialogue_survivors: She is my sister, and it is my throne. I must do this.
No! I am your Queensguard. It MUST be me!
The Kazurai got us into this mess. Skywrath is in ruins because of me. It should be me.
It can only be one of you! Choose your champion!
Do you know WHY they call it the Nest of Thorns?
Oh, how DELIGHTFUL that you're about to find out.
Unfurl the wings of WRATH and RUIN!
You POISONED the minds of the masses. Unleashed a MOB to kill me.
RRROAAAAR!
You can't blame me for summoning a few mobs of my own to kill YOU.
Avilliva's power is just a gateway. When I'm finished here, there are even MORE gods to kill.
I worked so HARD.
We tortured, we bribed, we murdered, we maimed! To CRUSH the Kazurai before this rebellion took hold.
But I also made OTHER plans... Of course, the NOBLE sacrifice of my people pains me. But their deaths have unlocked the power of GODHOOD.
ANYONE would make that trade.
Wow! Helping you kill this @#$% is going to be even more fun than I thought!
If Imperia wants to face my champion, I've found one.
The Goddess honors me!
Not you, buddy.
But why are we going in one by one again?
Well, good luck. After everything we've been through, it sure would be a shame if you died right at the end.
Destroy Imperia and restore my godhood!
I mean, restore my KINGDOM.
I mean, restore OUR kingdom! Yes.
And away we go!
Well, away YOU go.
But I am definitely in your corner, friend!
I'm even waiving my standard fee.
For Shen!
For Skywrath!
For the Flightless!
I notice NO ONE said anything about me!
Dragonus, I said you could have ONE day, not—
Yeah, listen lady. I know you got some BIG speech planned for your wayward boytoy, but I ain't him.
One of the Kazurai... I thought I KILLED you. If you're leading the flightless, I must have killed the OTHER one. The OLD man.
Kraw. Yeah, he's fine. On vacation even. Lotsa sand... Look, you only get to kill your first tyrant once, so what do say we just...?
I'm going to enjoy hanging your carcass from the Midgate.
You got real problems, lady.
Careful, little bird. I might also have some problems for you!
You think a few Queensguard can stop me? We already killed most of those jerks.
RRROAAAAR!
Ah ha ha ha! Who said anything about Queensguard?
Crap. I should have listened closer to Bakeet's story about Avilliva and those sardines...
You're one of the Kazurai... I thought I KILLED you. How delightful to get to do that face to face!
I'm going to enjoy HANGING your CARCASS from the Midgate.
You got REAL problems, lady.
Your legend GROWS, little bird. It's a shame everyone who knows it is about to be DEAD.
There's something I've always wanted to know about you... And I guess this is our last chance.
Are you just a NATURALLY gifted piece of work or does that take a lot of practice?
What was I thinking? 'No, Princess. The Flightless need to strike this blow.' Why did I VOLUNTEER for this?
You ALWAYS do stupid stuff to help people. It's why you're so great!
What was I thinking? 'No, Princess. The Flightless need to strike this blow.' Why did I VOLUNTEER for this?
You ALWAYS do stupid stuff to help people. It's why you're so great!
RRROAAAAR!
Well... good luck!
This isn't about the throne. Bring justice to our people. YOU'RE the one the kingdom needs.
I'll get you your crown, princess. For Skywrath.
Can you believe we're friends with a queen?
Hear me, hero of the Flightless! The moment has come to—
Yep, I'm ready to go!
... At least let me finish the rousing speech!
Imperia won't know what hit her.
I can HEAR you, you know.
Okay, well... Now you DO know.
Crap.
Why are you going alone? Are you going to be okay?
It's just another trip topside, buddy. When have things ever gone south?
Lots of times! Almost every single time we go!
Prepare to die, Imperia!
And who are you again...?
That's Kestrel! You would've met sooner but he's been hiding from you in Icewrack!
Turn back, little flightless, before I put you in a cage of pain.
You and what army? We already destroyed the Queensguard.
I can always find another army. That's what makes me a queen, little bird.
RRROAAAAR!
How convenient! There they are now.
Can we forget I asked about the army?
Dragonus. I give you ONE day to mourn, and you sneak off to start a revolution!
No, sister. Dragonus used your leave to resurrect ME.
SHEN?! You— You CAN'T be here.
I'm the one who started the revolution, with the help of some new friends.
You're dead. I KILLED you. You're not ALLOWED to be here!
I've been thinking about this moment for a LONG time. About what I would say, what YOU would say...and the look on your face...
You... Abomination! The highborn of Skywrath won't follow YOU!
The highborn AREN'T the only ones in Skywrath. Everyone else would follow anyone that kills you.
I AM this city! And did you forget? I already killed you once.
You HAD me killed once. And I spent YEARS fighting gods and monsters to get back here. There's no one left to protect you.
I don't NEED protection from you! Ugh! All this talking to a dead woman bores me... Did you leave your 'new friends' elsewhere? Why don't we meet some of mine?
RRROAAAAR!
We probably should have listened to that Avilliva warning from Bakeet.
SHEN?! You— You CAN'T be here. You're dead. I KILLED you!
You're not ALLOWED to be here!
Yes, remember how you TORE OFF my wings? I wanted to share a few...FEELINGS about that.
SHEN?! You— You're dead. I KILLED you!
Yes, sister. That was just ONE of your crimes. I'd get to the others before I kill YOU...
But it's a long list and between MY laughing and stabbing and YOUR screaming and dying? We have far better uses for our time.
SHEN?! You— You're dead. I KILLED you!
Yes, and you want to know something, sister?
I took that @#$% to the grave.
Now we take back the crown!
All this trouble for some stupid hat.
You wouldn't say that if it were a stupid BELT she's after.
Tread carefully, Oglodi...
Imperia! It's time to END this.
Welcome home, sister! I never DREAMED I'd get the chance to kill you again.
Aww, that's so sweet.
Vengeance is finally at hand.
Face the feathers of fury!
She's got this one covered, buddy.
Are you ready to die, Imperia?
Why don't you ask my new friends?
The city burns around you, Imperia.
It's perfect for your funeral pyre!
The people of Skywrath will celebrate this day.
The day the reign of Imperia ENDS.
Dragonus. I give you ONE day to mourn, and you sneak off to start a revolution! Have you come to apologize? To THROW yourself at my feet?
No, Imperia. I've come to reclaim the rightful throne of the TRUE Skywrath queen.
Oh? Did you find one of the flightless rabble to lead you? You're moving on from my sister! It would kill dear Shen all over again to find that out.
Queen Shendelzare lives! I resurrected her myself. And she does me the greatest honor of my life by letting me bring her your head.
Ha ha ha! Dragonus, you've finally lost it. If Shen WERE alive, she'd want to see to me — to rub this revolution in my face!
She's grown a lot since you killed her. It's not about vengeance anymore. She sees a cancer in this kingdom that needs to be cut out.
I'm her sharpest knife.
Touching. But isn't that the trick with cancers, Dragonus? You turn your back for a SINGLE moment and—
RRROAAAAR!
Wouldn't you know it? They've grown.
At least it's me here in Shen's place... Thank Avilliva for Bakeet's portents about the sardines.
I KNOW what you've been up to, Dragonus. Out there, PLOTTING with the Flightless to overthrow me.
Yes, and now we come to the END of my schemes.
I'm here to reclaim the rightful throne of the TRUE Skywrath queen.
I KNOW what you've been up to, Dragonus. Out there, PLOTTING with the Flightless to overthrow me.
We've both always known the only way this ends is with your death.
I KNOW what you've been up to, Dragonus. Out there, PLOTTING with the Flightless to overthrow me.
We've both always known the only way this ends is with your death.
RRROAAAAR!
Did I mention I've already replaced you?
Imperia! Show yourself!
RRROAAAAR!
If you want MY attention, Dragonus? You'll have to earn it.
Imperia will pay a steep price for her villainy.
Wait, we're FINING her? I thought we were gonna kill her.
We... we are. It was a figure of speech.
Ohhh. You don't usually use figures of speech, I wasn't ready for it.
What? I use figures of speech!
No, she's right, you're pretty dull. I was confused too.
Well, good luck, Fancy Wings!
For possibly the last time, I remind you my name is Dragonus.
Haw! Whatever you say, Fancy Dragonus!
How does it feel to be a TRAITOR, Dragonus?
Your hypocrisy knows no bounds.
Yes, I've accomplished a lot that way!
I WILL win back your throne.
Just come back to me alive.
Are we HUGGING now? Can I get in?!
For your love, Shen, I will fight to the death!
Aw, that's so romantic.
That's true love.
No, I meant the part about fighting to the death.
Skywrath's TRUE queen will rise again!
Is that so? I suppose I'll have to throw her off the balcony again.
Whoa! Wicked!
I mean, it's TERRIBLE, but you know, it's still pretty sick!
Ugh, how do you KEEP getting stronger?
You SHOULD just give up, but for some reason your struggle CONTINUES...
You're going to need a LOT more help than that.
Why hasn't someone KILLED you yet?
Who will they send to fight me after YOU die?
I'll make GOOD use of that power after you die.
They don't know who they're messing with!
The Flightless are with you!
Can you believe everything we've been through?
Just a little more!
*grunt*
He's saying good luck.
*grunt*
I can't tell them that!
Feel the wrath of my power!
Feel the wrath of my power!
Yeah! Feel really really BAD about it!
Bakeet, I love ya buddy, but we really gotta work on your trash talk.
Now you’ll see what a guard to the REAL queen can do!
A great power grows from within.
My powers will tear the flesh from their bones.
Geez. I'm glad we're on your side.
We're still on your side, right?
You have my bolt.
And my wrench!
Arcane bolt!
Frostbite! Why are we shouting our powers?
Take my arcane bolt.
It'll give 'em a jolt.
No! We are NOT rhyming things.
The sword-bird has bony wings.
A bolt to sting any that face you!
By the powers of Scree'Auk and Skywrath combined!
A bolt to TEAR through our enemies.
Yeah, rip 'em to SHREDS!
You two can keep trying, but you are NEVER going to make magic sound cool.
For the sake of Shendelzare, let the powers of Skywrath flow through me!
Oh man, this is great.
Wooohooo, now we're talking!
For the Kazurai!
For Kraw!
Too bad Kraw can't see this. My form would make him so mad.
It's time for the Flightless to rise.
This one kind of echoes!
ECHOES...Echoes...echoes...
My blade will always be with you. As long as you don't die.
I'll do what I can to help.
And I'll help him do that!
I know you won't let our people down.
Yeah, there's A LOT riding on this.
Thanks for the powerup, me! You're welcome, me!
Hey, quit hogging all the helping.
I grow stronger by the minute.
Yes, yes, you're very mighty.
The way of the Kazurai guides me.
Nothing will stop me from ending this.
By the power of Scree'Auk!
I'm really looking forward to having some of that power BACK, by the way... Kill faster!
By the power of Scree'Auk!
This is MY throne room!
For Skywrath.
I grant myself ultimate power!
You can DO that? Why were you waiting?!
You have not yet seen the extent of my power!
I already died here years ago. I could live without doing it again.
May these missiles rend their bodies AND their souls.
I love it when she talks like that!
Set Skywrath free, for ALL our people.
That's my queen!
I don't care about vengeance. Bring JUSTICE to our people. Use whatever power you need.
This power belongs to the people of Skywrath, not just their queen.
I might become queen, but YOU'LL become legend.
That's a LIVING legend, right?
Ask any favor of me, Kazurai. I will grant it.
All I have, all that I am, is yours.
Even in my darkest days, Dragonus, you were the light.
We're so close, Shen. Set us free!
At least with this you can go out SWINGING.
Yes. Alone, you will most certainly die.
Axe assists!
Centaur also assists!
Get your own thing!
Did someone ask for Axe?
They need a cutting tool.
Yep, that's me!
This one's REALLY great for killing enemies.
What's it do?
I just said, it kills enemies!
Line their CORPSES as signposts on the cold road to death!
You know, sis? We should really spend more time together.
Good luck! Give 'em all frostbite!
Tell me ALL the gory details when you get back.
Chill 'em to the bone. That's what hurts the most.
Ooh, have you ever seen a corpse shatter?
BLOODSICLES!
There's NOTHING more painful than frostbite.
Nay, frostbite is naught but the bracing kiss of winter! Compared to feeling your bones and organs exploding into mist against the glorious charge of a Marrowfell—
Blood mist?! That sounds almost instantaneous. Trust me, I've written extensive scrolls on it. Frostbite is WAY worse.
Thank you, Rylai. I will use this power judiciously.
Always so formal. Just go freeze their faces off!
You could do me no greater honor.
You honor us both by killing my sister.
I do this for you.
Do it for BOTH of us. Do it for everyone who suffers under my sister's rule.
This should heat things up.
Can you please get a new catchphrase? You've been saying that one since we were twelve.
It's a classic for a reason.
Fire kills everything. Demons, things that aren't demons. Everything.
What about FIRE demons?
It should interest you that birds are on the 'things that aren't demons' side of that list.
EEP!
You got a problem to solve? You call down the fire. It's tried and true. Gods and sorcerers do it, soldiers and farmers do it, and now YOU can do it too.
Hey, thanks for including conventional fire in your list!
That's the beauty of fire. It wants to burn so badly, even morons can bring it to life.
Hey, we got a CONTRACT! Save those bodies for me.
What, for science?
For LUNCH!
This'll tenderize their meat.
By ROTTING it.
To. Per. Fection.
Oh that's a nice stench.
I've seen a lot, as a god, and you... you are truly disgusting.
Aww, thanks!
Rot. Death. Decay. Just a few of me favorite things.
Here ya go, mate. The gift of rot.
Now that's some choice stink!
Blast!
Kill!
Maim...
Who said that?
You can't spell magic without T-E-C-H!
I think you actually can spell magic without T-E-C-H.
There's a LOT of words you can spell without it, now that I—
Just push the cart, pal.
They brought monsters to a bomb fight!
Is that bad for us?
Not at all! Demons explode REAL good. Here, watch!
Careful! This is experimental.
You're our TEST subject!
Congratulations, kiddo! You're gonna be famous.
Is that actually SAFE to use? I thought we were still working on it.
What do you mean? This IS 'working on it'.
FIELD testing?!
Excellent. I'll take notes.
You're DYING out there.
LITERALLY dying!
Wow, the 'no blood' strategy. I love that one!
But you have to be a lot tougher than YOU to pull that one off.
Quick, find some food! Worms, cheese, a parfait, anything!
You don't look so good.
If only you'd caught more fish!
Food.
You'd better eat something. You don't wanna make Gralla mad!
Ha ha ha! Bleed for me!
What's wrong? You don't look well!
I'm starting to think you might not make it.
Do you need a moment to rest?
I must keep going...
Shen needs me...
Anyone remember where I saw that cheese?
You ever eat cheese from a bluehorn?
It's even worse than their milk!
You want it grilled?
Eat.
Wish I had some worms to share. Ooh! Or sardines!
A potent and timely cheese!
Yes, I watched Axe succumb to fried curd once. Though he struggled mightily, he did not reach the latrines.
Did you see how far away they were? What kind of moron digs them there?
Where's all the meat?
Yeah, why does Imperia have so much cheese?
Did you check for mold?
You eat food off the ground? Gross.
All my food comes off the ground.
I just watched you dig up a corpse and eat it.
Below ground's even better!
The floor cheese will heal you.
Or give you rumble guts!
That doesn't matter now, just eat it!
How dare you. That cheese was a gift!
Oh dang, it might be poisoned! Spit it out!
I forgot how much I love food.
Being dead has its downsides, huh?
... Yes. One or two.
Nothing tastes better than food in a battle!
What else would you taste?
You don't want to know.
Heal me now, keel me later.
Ha! Good one, lad!
I don't get it.
Time to soften you up a bit.
Whoa, that guy's huge!
I disagree. He is barely larger than a small giant.
I'd say medium.
Save some for Imperia!
But definitely USE enough that you live that long!
Look out!
This should be some good practice before the main event.
Fight. Good.
I've got something special. I think you'll like it.
My intuition tells me this bird witch is not sincere.
Oh no, what's THAT?!
Something NEW to watch 'em kill. Neat!
Imperia sends you fresh meat.
Did someone say 'fresh meat'?
I've still got my cleaver!
The time has come. Save OUR people. Kill Imperia and take back the throne!
You must kill Imperia or Skywrath is doomed!
Save the kingdom. Save yourself. Most importantly, save ME!
Years of struggle and it all comes down to this.
Have fun!
This is what you came for. Finish her here.
I hope you're strong enough... It's time to win this war!
Time.
I knew YOU could survive! Now go kill that stupid queen!
I offer the gift of death.
What's the return policy on that?
You wanted to see the queen? Well, come closer, because here I am!
I can see fine from here, thanks!
Torch this lady!
Put her on ice!
Lina... We're bonding!
GET HER!
Kill her and let's get out of here!
If we cannot ride into battle together, I will at least watch you draw royal blood from nearby.
You got this!
I know you can do this...
But I can't watch!
Hello, sister. I would say it's good to see you, but I went through SO much trouble to kill you the first time, the least you could have done was stay dead.
On second thought, it IS good to see you. After all, do you know how great it feels to indulge in a little fratricide?
Believe me, sister, I'm about to find out.
Shen, before I kill you again, I just want you to know...
What?
I almost shed a tear when I killed you the first time.
It's everything we dreamed of. Now's our chance.
Dragonus...
You two can get poetic afterwards! Just end this!
This is it, my love. The last step to reclaiming your life.
For you, for Skywrath, for the DEAD! Long live the true queen!
For the Kazurai and the flightless that rise from below! I've finally found you.
Brave little bird. Are you always so eager to die?
Hey, Bakeet?
Yeah, Kez?
I was just thinking how if you never got arrested by Imperia's goons, we might not even be here.
Sorry.
No, what I meant was... Thank you.
You're the hero of the Flightless, Kez. You're MY hero. You got this!
You got this, Kez! You're the hero of the Flightless!
You're MY hero, buddy. Hang tight, I'll be right back.
My market stall's not running itself. Kill her and let's go home!
This market stall, you sell RANCID meat?
Gosh, I got all kinds!
Be careful, Dragonus. Her powers rival a god's now... We have no idea what she can do.
Whatever she unleashes, it won't be enough.
Welcome home, Dragonus. I've MISSED you.
Kill her and let's get out of here!
I've told you, we wish to rule this kingdom! It is Shen's birthright.
Then kill her so the REST OF US can get out of here!
Yes, this victory must be followed by a mighty feast!
Come back to me alive, my love. I know how awful it feels to be dead.
I would die a thousand deaths to rid you of Imperia.
I only need ONE death. Hers.
Be careful, Dragonus.
I've already won as long as you're alive.
Watch out!
I CAN'T watch!
Do not fear, little bird. He was not talking to you. He was talking to your friend who's about to die.
Okay, whew!
Taste true power!
You can save ME a bit. I like tastin' things too!
Watch out for her attacks!
Everybody duck!
Oh wait, the rest of us are probably fine over here.
She's using a special power!
Uh oh.
Goggles, everyone!
ALL of you will die!
There is no greater honor than to fall in combat.
Really? Honor sounds kind of dumb.
I don't need Skywrath anymore. Let the city CRUMBLE!
Get out of my Nest!
We do not approve!
Careful, it's a very long drop!
So THIS is what a god feels like!
I win.
You came all that way just to die.
There are some timely openings in my Queensguard... but you failed the audition.
You know the old wisdom about coming at the queen? You missed.
Remember when I said this plan sucked?
Someone get a healer!
Someone get a cart!
Someone get my apron!
Well, there goes my godhood.
And our friend!
That's sad too. But there's only ONE thing you can do in times like this: try to kill Imperia again. Immediately. Not YOU specifically, Bakeet. You're my last follower.
But I brought my cleaver and everything...
What is that idiot DOING?
I believe the strategy is called 'playing dead'. It is a well known ploy of cowards and children.
It's a convincing act!
Boy, is Imperia in for a surprise!
We DID it!
Yes, we all share in the glories of this victorious, bloodsoaked day. Surely ours are deeds worthy of esteem only belts can recognize.
Perfect. Belts for everyone!
Even me?
Especially you, buddy. I'd still be up in Icewrack if it weren't for you. You're the linchpin, the glue!
Impossible!
Nothing's impossible with the power of friendship!
Or the power of Scree'Auk, as it happens. So chop chop, let's get those people back to worshipping me.
Noooo!
Yesssss!
Those guidebooks were right. The Nest of Thorns is really neat!
DOTA_VData_survivors_powerups_annihilati: Unleash physical vengeance upon many enemies around you. High damage, long cooldown.
Skree'auk blesses you with an extra life.
DOTA_VData_survivors_powerups_arcane_bol: Shoots a damaging projectile at the closest enemy.
DOTA_VData_survivors_powerups_chain_fros: Shoots a slow-moving projectile at the closest enemy, dealing damage, slowing the area, and then bouncing to another enemy.
Each time Chain Frost bounces to a new target, it has a 50% chance to split into two projectiles.
DOTA_VData_survivors_powerups_counter_he: Hits enemies around you, damaging them and knocking them back.
{f:0:counter_chance}% to trigger when you receive damage.
DOTA_VData_survivors_powerups_echo_strik: Hits enemies in a line in front of you. Additional strikes will clone the original.
Echo Slash both in front and behind you.
DOTA_VData_survivors_powerups_frostbite_: Freezes the strongest enemy in range and making them take more damage from projectile attacks.
Enemies that die while frostbitten will shatter, causing nearby enemies to be frostbitten.
DOTA_VData_survivors_powerups_kez_innate: Kez has bonus movement speed and will periodically mark the strongest nearby enemies, causing the next Physical attack to critically strike.
DOTA_VData_survivors_powerups_laguna_bla: Damages the strongest enemy in range with a bolt of lightning.
Laguna blade can target the same enemy multiple times.
DOTA_VData_survivors_powerups_land_mine_: Plants a proximity mine at your position. After an arming period the mine will be triggered by nearby enemies.
Can now plant Stasis Traps and Remote Mines
DOTA_VData_survivors_powerups_magic_miss: Shoots a projectile at the closest enemy, damaging it and stunning nearby enemies.
Does {f:2:damage_per_enemy} more damage per enemy killed using Magic Missile (currently {f:1:extra_damage})
DOTA_VData_survivors_powerups_mortimer_k: Launches firespit globs at random targets, causing damage over time in an area.
Enemies killed with Mortimer's Kisses have a chance to spawn a healing cookie.
